branches.query: Software that quantifies microscopy images for cell biology researchers
branches.rationale: Names one tool function and scientific user, rather than research-services vocabulary. Semantic mode is documented and avoids hybrid lexical emphasis on names containing emerging. Hypothesis: the returned pool will contain more task-specific tool builders; this has not been tested.
branches.scope_basis: Mandate sections 3 R and 6 R: microscopy analysis, repeatable research tool and scientist user.
semantic_checks: Resolve the actual builder and named analysis product
Inspect representative microscopy input/output, tutorial, repository or measured comparison when accessible
Distinguish reusable image analysis from custom analysis services and hardware distribution
recall_limitations: Samples only microscopy software, not full R coverage
Commercial and open-source builders may appear; do not infer company asset rights
No stage preference is encoded; maturity and known-YC status remain downstream context

search.query: Software that quantifies microscopy images for cell biology researchers

branches.query: Companies commercializing blood-based molecular diagnostic tests for cancer detection
branches.rationale: Names sample type, diagnostic mechanism and intended clinical use instead of generic medical innovation, development consulting or artifact wishlists. Hypothesis: results will better identify test developers; no account relevance guarantee is claimed.
branches.scope_basis: Mandate sections 3 D and 6 D: diagnostic test with defined intended use, patient population and appropriate validation context.
semantic_checks: Resolve company and named blood-based molecular test
Identify intended population/use and actual clinical action before interpreting performance
Inspect prototype/study evidence and distinguish test developer from consultant, reseller or ordinary clinic
recall_limitations: Samples one D use case, not all diagnostics/devices
Commercializing is retrieval language, not a sales, clearance or qualification gate
Mature incumbents and screening/recurrence uses may appear; record actual scope, stage and novelty rather than inferring them

execution_conditions: Control must explicitly amend the paid-call scope before backend executes either branch; this file is not an approval record.
Backend alone binds the exact query/mode/limit/current reference hash and catalog to new scoped approval records, persists raw responses before normalization and retains original/recovery receipts.
No provider filters, People/Enrich calls, automatic retries, pagination or further query expansion.
Deduplicate against all existing original/recovered candidates and known-company universe; preserve encounter lineage, deferred/excluded reasons and actual unique count.
Do not increase the existing nine-successful-assessment target or force nine researchable/positive cases. Artifact/founder/scientific checks remain downstream; no new fund gate.
